title: Khúc ru muộn
about: Round 25, ke-chuyen ("bạn hãy tự sáng tác những bản khác hay hơn, phối theo kiểu bạn đề xuất"): E minor in 3/4 at 66 bpm, a late lullaby. Its motif climbs the chord (B-E-G) and sighs down a step onto the beat (F#-E over E minor; G-F# over B7, a dark leaning note); the middle section in G major sung twice reaches E6. The arc: the piano alone; the cellos' slow second line; the climax with the strings and the piano's rolled chords; the piano again with the violas at the sentences' ends; the climbing motif and its sigh to close. An original tune.
